ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT, made as of this L day of February, 2005 (this “Agreement"), betweenPARKCHESTERPRESERVATIONCOMPANY,L.P.,aNewYorklimited partnership, having an office at 1385 Metropolitan Avenue, Bronx, New York 10462 ("Seller") and PARKCHESTER PRESERVATION COMPANY,L.P., a NewYork limited partnership, having an address at 1385 Metropolitan Avenue, Bronx, New York 10462 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. York, County of Bronx, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof and designated on the Land and Tax Map of the City of New York, New York as Lot 207 in Block 3943, together with the improvements presently located thereon (said land being herein referred to as “Seller's Land,” and said existing improvements being herein referred to as "Seller's Existing Building,” and Seller's Land and Seller's Existing Building being herein referred to as“Seller's Property"). B.Developer is the owner of certain land adjacent to Seller's Land located in the City and State of New York, County of Bronx, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof and designated on the Land and Tax Map of the City of New York, New York as Lot 205 in Block 3943, together with the existing improvements, if any, thereon (said land being herein referred to as “Developer's Land” and said improvements, if C. Developer may(but in no event shallbe obligated to)renovate Developer's Existing Building, if any,and/or or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land or other adjacent land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, whether upon Developer's Land or other adjacent land, being herein referred to as“Developer's Proposed Building” and Developer's Land and Developer's Proposed Building being herein referred to as "Developer's Property"). D. Seller and Developer wish to merge Developer's Property and Seller's   go o    si n s s  , s  o  Resolution of theCity of New York,effectiveDecember 15,1961(as amended todate,the "Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot"); E.As used herein “Floor Area Development Rights"” shall mean certain rights,as determined by the Zoning Resolution,which are appurtenant to a zoning lot,whereby such zoning lot may be developed by erecting thereon one or more structures with Floor Area (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) determined by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the allowable Floor Area Ratio (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in that zoning district. F.As used herein "Excess Development Rights"” shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Seller's Land in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the improvements located on Seller's Land on the date hereof, plus,upon the demolition,destruction or removal of Seller's Existing Building, all Floor Area Development Rights that were appurtenant or otherwise attributable to such building. G. The parties hereto have been advised that on the date hereof, Seller's Existing Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and that, therefore, Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that,under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution,may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available. H. Seller wishes to sell to Developer, and Developer wishes to purchase, the Excess Development Rights in order that Developer's Proposed Building be permitted to have Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available and, in any event, that Developer shall be the owner of the Excess Development Rights. I. Zoning Lot Restrictions (the“Declaration") dated of even date herewith,which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the NewYork County Office of the Register of The City of New York with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot.  J. Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and Seller's Land and Developer's Land are all within a single block. NOW,THEREFORE,the parties agrees asfollows: ARTICLE1 GRANTOFEASEMENTANDDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 1.1. Seller hereby grants, transfers and conveys to Developer all the Excess Development Rights, to the extent permitted by applicable law, and consents to Developer's use for any lawful purpose, or conveyance, of the Excess Development Rights, to have and to hold the Excess Development Rights and the right to use or convey the Excess Development Rights by Developer, its successors and assigns. Except for Additional Rights (as hereinafter defined) acquired by Developer with respect to which the provisions of Article 4 hereof shall govern, and the Excess Development Rights, any additional Floor Area Development Rights that may become appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot arising by any means, including, but not limited to, the demolition, destruction or removal of all or any part of Seller's Existing Building or a modification of the Zoning Resolution or other change in existing law,shall be allocated in their entirety solely to Developer's Property for the benefit and exclusive use of Developer, its successors or assigns.
